limits: All raw cells retained, including literal suppression/rounds-to-zero tokens and source defects.
Sex/race and age rates use all adults; only the separate overall table uses citizen adults.
Native confidence fields are literal: workbook confidence level and half-width interpretation not independently established.
Counts are rounded weighted population thousands, not respondent counts or precision guarantees.
Native racial labels remain exact; no automatic equivalence to later race-alone/in-combination categories.
Suppressed rates are not reconstructed. Group views overlap and are not additive.
Repeated cross-sections do not establish fixed-person transitions, 2026 voting or local demographic rates.
Candidate rates still require precision/disclosure/public-selection review; no public display approved.
